slides.title: Objects I / Desert and machines
texts: Every visible model is generated in code, assembled from indexed meshes, and shaded in real time.
ARRAKIS / HARVESTER DOWN     |     ASIQUE EHETASAMUL HAQUE     |     CSE 4102

900 x 900 patch; 260 x 260 cells.
Height field, smooth normals, flat base terrace.

Eight wings; hull/canopy, intakes, gimbals,
turbines/nozzles, tail, sensor and fixed skids.

Four crawlers, wheels/pads, cutter drum,
exit/ramp, separators, bridge, stacks and lamps.

Cradle/skids, cylinder vessel, domed ends,
bands, hatch/valve and emissive indicator.

Eight sites x four pieces: irregular facets,
different scales, strata and procedural grain.

Cube + cylinder + ellipsoid + wing mesh.
Parent/local transforms reuse GPU geometry.
Inspection close-ups reuse actual project draw routines. Terrain is a scene capture. No imported models or image textures.

slides.title: Curved geometry / The equations behind the objects
texts: Curved geometry / The equations behind the objects
Parameters control shape; triangles sample the equations; normals control lighting.
ARRAKIS / HARVESTER DOWN     |     ASIQUE EHETASAMUL HAQUE     |     CSE 4102

Broad dunes + sharper ridges + small undulations.
Base flattening: smooth blend from radius 15 to 25.
A/B/C: half-axis lengths; cylinder: unit height, radius 0.5.
Torus a/b: major-circle / tube angles; radii 1 and 0.025.
WORM BODY / bend a radial surface

C(t): buried cubic Bezier + curved 64-unit neck.
t: along body; a: ring angle; T: centreline tangent.
rho: radius + 32 ridges/grain + mouth taper.
Profile revolution creates lip, funnel and throat.

R/S: radial/tangential; r/d: row radius/depth.
l: reach; c: curl; D: drop; w: base width; t: base -> tip.
A readable equation-to-object mapping: dunes, hull/tank/worker curves, beacon rings, flexible worm and curved teeth.

slides.title: Complex motion / One changing rescue scene
texts: Complex motion / One changing rescue scene
Objects move independently, while mission events change what the player can rescue and what remains visible.
ARRAKIS / HARVESTER DOWN     |     ASIQUE EHETASAMUL HAQUE     |     CSE 4102

k = 5.5 normal / 12 braking; speeds 28 / 48 units/s.
Terrain following + pitch/bank; analytically smoothed yaw.
Wing angles in degrees; phase 23 -> 36 rad/s; twist/exhaust.
Tracks/drum follow distance travelled, not idle clock time.

t: seconds; tangent heading and slope alignment.
Groups release at 6 + 7j s; crew run at 3.8 units/s.
Worm gap: 220 -> 18; limbs animate; radius/height hazards.
Current breach: 150 s; then 60 s final extraction.
TITLE  >  FLIGHT / EVACUATION  >  BREACH / HARVESTER LOSS  >  EXTRACTION  >  DEBRIEF / RETRY / NEXT

slides.title: Game-like controls / Fly, inspect, rescue
texts: The aircraft and the mission respond to input; changing view does not change the aircraft's heading.
ARRAKIS / HARVESTER DOWN     |     ASIQUE EHETASAMUL HAQUE     |     CSE 4102
Hover steers yaw + camera pitch; centre dead zone

Safety: altitude 4-55; rock/harvester clearance help.
Focus loss pauses and clears held input; reset/resize
recentres the cursor. Movement stays inside +/-160.

Smooth follow + terrain-safe eye; 58-degree perspective.
All are third-person, including the close preset.
SPACE / RESCUE IS A STATE CHANGE

Pickup: distance <12, height <=11, speed <6.
Hold 0.42 s/person; cabin capacity = 8.
Deliver: base distance <14; hold 1.2 s per load.

Inside -> Running/Waiting -> Aboard -> Safe
Only Safe increases score; danger/timeout can cause Lost.
ENTER start/next   |   P pause   |   R retry   |   M mute   |   F wireframe   |   F11 fullscreen   |   ESC exit

slides.title: Rendering / What makes the scene convincing
texts: Rendering / What makes the scene convincing
A forward OpenGL renderer: one shadow target, then the visible frame, particles, and the interface.
ARRAKIS / HARVESTER DOWN     |     ASIQUE EHETASAMUL HAQUE     |     CSE 4102

Directional Blinn-Phong + sand-wrap diffuse.
5 x 5 PCF; receiver-plane correction + bias.
Glossy opaque surfaces; emissive ornaments.

Sand ripples, bump-like normals and sparkle.
Rock strata/grain; no bitmap texture files.
Sky gradient, sun disc/halo, distance fog, tone mapping.

2,400 particles: wind/crawler/worm/downwash.
Sorted instances + lifetime/alpha fades.
Depth-tested, camera-facing billboards.
Crater: 13 units deep, tapers to radius 48.
Depth/culling + requested 4x MSAA; inverse-transpose normals. Crater is GPU-only: CPU ground/collision height is unchanged.
DEMO: inspect long shadows + surface detail; press F for triangle topology; show breach dust and the visual depression.
